preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 20 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between 0 and 400 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid node indices between 1 and n.
The number of parsed edges matches m.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' if has_hamiltonian_path(n, edges) else stdout.strip() == 'No'
postconditions.description: Output 'Yes' if the graph contains a Hamiltonian path, otherwise 'No'.

postconditions.expression: has_hamiltonian_path(n, edges) == any(all((p[i], p[i+1]) in edge_set or (p[i+1], p[i]) in edge_set for i in range(n-1)) for p in permutations(range(1, n+1)))
postconditions.description: A Hamiltonian path exists if there is a permutation of all nodes where every consecutive pair is connected by an edge in the undirected graph.
